_about_config: clawbot-companion example config. Copy to config.json and fill in your own values. Never commit config.json. Keys starting with _about_ are comments and are ignored by the code.
_about_content_pack_dir: Directory holding wardrobe.md / scene_cards.md / expressions.md / looks.md (relative to the data directory, or absolute).
_about_limits: Per-reply length and style limits. bridge.py's numeric hard gate reads THIS section (config key names below); any missing/invalid key falls back to the built-in constant with the same value as shown here.
_about_llm: LLM settings. mode=api uses an OpenAI-compatible API; mode=agent uses file-based agent wakeup (see docs/agent-mode.md).
_about_media: Optional media generation switches for YOUR generator integration (see docs/media-and-tts.md). The core bridge/proactive code does not read this section; proactive media form weights live in proactive.rhythm.photo_p / video_p.
_about_proactive: Proactive (initiated) messages. Structure below matches proactive.py exactly: flat keys on the proactive object, per-slot windows under slots, and cadence/tuning keys grouped under rhythm. There are no nested impulse{} or silence{} objects in the code.
_about_state: There is no state_dir config key: runtime state always lives in <COMPANION_HOME>/state (COMPANION_HOME defaults to the program directory).
_about_tz: IANA timezone name. The code reads this exact key name: tz (bridge.py / proactive.py / tune.py).

limits._about_bracket: Bracket-style text emoticons like [微笑]: per-turn cap, plus a rolling cap across the last bracket_window_rounds reply turns.
limits._about_max_bubbles: Max message bubbles per reply turn

llm._about_api_key_env: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Do not put the key itself here. The code default (when this field is empty/missing) is COMPANION_LLM_API_KEY.
llm._about_model: Model name provided by your API provider

proactive._about_daily_max: Hard daily cap on proactive messages (after the observation period below).
proactive._about_flat_gates: Flat gate keys read directly from the proactive object.
proactive._about_flavors: Content flavour rotation for proactive messages (one is picked per message, avoiding recent repeats).
proactive._about_observation: Warm-up period: for the first observation_days days after first start, the daily cap is min(observation_cap, daily_max). It lifts early if the first replies are all answered.
proactive._about_quiet_hours: [start_hour, end_hour] local time, no proactive messages inside, e.g. [1, 7]
proactive._about_rhythm: Cadence and tuning keys, all read from proactive.rhythm by proactive.py. impulse keys live here (impulse_daily_max / impulse_p), NOT in a separate impulse object; followup_expire_hours also lives here.
proactive._about_send_jitter_min: Follow-up messages only: random send delay range in minutes [min, max]. Other intents use rhythm.jitter_min (capped at 10).
proactive._about_silence_flat: Long-silence trigger keys are FLAT on proactive (not under a silence object): silence_hours = user silent at least this many hours before a silence message may roll; silence_p = roll probability; silence_window = [start_hour, end_hour) local hours in which it may trigger.
proactive._about_slots: Per-slot window [start,end] in HH:MM and probability p (0-1) of sending in that slot. Slot names are the intent names: morning/lunch/evening/goodnight.
proactive._about_subjects: Media subjects for proactive photo/video messages. The first entry is the self-appearance subject, picked with rhythm.photo_self_p / video_self_p probability; the rest rotate by day.

rhythm._about_double_p: Chance of a short second follow-up bubble for silence/evening/lunch intents.
rhythm._about_gap_hours: Randomised gap between proactive messages, hours [min, max]; applied when a message is marked sent.
rhythm._about_media_weights: Relative weights when a proactive message may carry media: photo_p for morning/evening/silence, video_p for evening/silence/impulse. Both 0 = text only. Counts are not capped per form; only daily_max caps the total.
rhythm._about_silence_evening_hours: Silence threshold (hours) used in the evening (17:00-22:00) and as the weekend daytime cap, instead of proactive.silence_hours.
